title: Rafael and the Orbit
author: Elodie Okonkwo
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
